hero_title: YouTube on Xbox 360. No PC needed.
hero_description: Native 1080p30. Your account and Music. All on Xbox, without a PC or Xbox Live.
tv_label: Interactive Tube360 preview. Arrows navigate, Left opens the menu, Enter or A selects, Escape or B goes back.
desktop_help: arrows · Enter · Esc · Y search · S options · F2 filters
mobile_help: tap a video or use the buttons below
down: Move down or focus player options
disclosure: Try search, local lists, Music and the player. Sample content; the app runs on your Xbox 360.
how_description: Tube360 connects to YouTube over HTTPS. Your Xbox decodes H.264 video and AAC audio itself, and handles your account, phone pairing and Cast sound.

native.LocalLimit: Up to 200 videos · up to 500 positions
native.ManualQualityHelp: Manual quality stays fixed. Automatic profiles adapt to playback.
native.Display1080Help: For native 1080p, select 1080p (progressive) in Xbox Display Settings and use HDMI.
native.LargeTextHelp: Larger text and fewer columns. Always enabled on SD TVs.
native.SyncHelp: Adjust in steps of 40 ms. Positive values advance the picture.
native.LocalOnly: Saved here. Never sent to your account.
native.SearchPrompt: What do you want to watch?
native.CastChoose: In the YouTube app, tap Cast and choose
native.CastPath: Or: your profile > Settings > Watch on TV > Enter TV code
native.CastRemember: The code changes every 5 minutes. Pair once and your phone remembers this TV.
native.CastOffline: Cast is unavailable. Check the network connection.

footprint_description: Browse and watch on the console. Nothing runs on a PC.
server_options: 1080p30 was validated on the owner’s Xbox on November 25, 2026. 1080p output requires HDMI and dashboard 1080p progressive. At 720p output, downscaling can show aliasing in fast motion. Adaptive profiles can lower quality under load.
features_title_2: At the pace of your controller.
features_intro_1: From the next video to the next song, on your TV.
features_intro_2: Real rc4 PC app screens with sample data.
account_description: Connect with a TV code for recommendations, subscriptions, account playlists and Music. Watch later and resume also work without an account, saved separately on your console.
search_description: Suggestions as you type, recent searches and LB filters: type, duration, upload date and relevance or view count. Browse videos, channels and playlists with your controller.
cast_title: Your phone can take the lead
cast_description: Pair with the TV code in the Phone panel. The console does not yet appear by itself in the phone’s cast list. Google Nest / Cast speakers receive sound directly from Xbox; live streams use TV audio.
sleep_title: One less thing to switch off
sleep_description: Choose 15 minutes to 2 hours, or end of video. A warning, a volume fade, then the Xbox turns itself off. The timer runs on the console.
account_alt: Real rc4 library with artwork for local lists, history and fictional playlists
account_caption: The rc4 library. Account and console lists stay separate.
player_description: Select the Like or Dislike icon below the timeline without leaving the video.
maintenance_description: The app checks for signed updates. Open App updates, confirm the download, then reopen default.xex to install. Ed25519 verification and automatic rollback protect the previous app. Copy the full package once when upgrading from 0.3.1.
language_description: English, Portuguese, Spanish and Arabic. Arabic titles in every language, large text and Xbox One / Series button prompts.
install_intro: Copy the folder. Open the app. Pick a video.
requirements_console: An Xbox 360 that runs unsigned code.
requirements_hacks: BadUpdate, RGH or JTAG. Tested with BadUpdate + XeUnshackle + Aurora.
requirements_software: Correct console date/time for HTTPS. No PC or Xbox Live required.
requirements_other: For phone discovery and Nest, keep devices on the same home network.
step_1_description: Extract the ZIP or .7z. Copy the complete Tube360 folder to writable Xbox storage: default.xex, tube360.xex, all eight fonts and license notices.
step_2_description: Keep both XEX files and all eight fonts together. Launch default.xex from Aurora, FSD or XeXMenu.
step_3_description: Search and watch without signing in. Optionally link your account in Settings with a TV code. Phone pairing uses a separate code in Phone.
star_description: Tube360 is a small, open source project. A GitHub star helps people discover it and follow its progress. If you enjoy bringing your console back to life, leave a star.
legal: Tube360 is not affiliated with YouTube, Google or Microsoft. YouTube is a trademark of Google LLC. Xbox 360 is a trademark of Microsoft.

next_description: At the end of a video, an 8-second countdown gives you time to choose: A to watch now, B to cancel.

members_alt: Tube360 notice that a video is only for channel members
hd_description: Validated on the owner’s Xbox: action at 30.00 fps without frame loss; football at 29.97 fps with one sync correction per minute, matching 720p. Sharp 1080p output with HDMI and dashboard 1080p progressive; 720p output downscales and can show aliasing in fast motion.
original_description: Original audio preferred over automatic dubbing. Choose other offered tracks in the player.
live_description: Press Y to skip a marked sponsor, self-promotion or subscription reminder, or enable automatic skipping. Intros/outros stay. Community marks may be inaccurate; live and audio-only Music are excluded.
network_description: Save a video with Start → Watch later · console. Open a partly watched video to continue or start over, even without an account. Local lists stay separate from your account.
why_description: Your old Xbox can be your living-room YouTube player again, with your account and controller in one native app. Free, open source, and built to run without another computer.
account_notice: I use it every day with my Premium account, with no warning so far. It is an unofficial client and things can change; use a secondary account if you prefer.
ai_notice: Made with AI assistance, reviewed and tested on the owner’s Xbox. Fat board families have no physical acceptance test; Arabic still needs native-speaker review.
roadmap_description: Recent plays, playlists and liked music use your existing TV account grant. A public catalogue is labeled when used as fallback. Account access and recommendations still need real-account console validation.
verification: VirusTotal: final scan link and executable SHA-256 pending. Package hashes accompany the release.
badge_alt: Members-only badge on TV Palmeiras videos
gallery_note: Captured from the real rc4 PC app, without a personal account. Sample catalogues, artwork and segments do not represent a live session.
comments_description: Scroll comments with the controller. Dislike counts are estimates from Return YouTube Dislike.
comments_alt: Fictional Demo comments in the native player
speed_description: Eight speeds from 0.25× to 2× preserve voice pitch. Repeat the video; the sleep timer still takes priority. Changed speed uses TV sound.
crt_description: 4:3 / 480, safe margins and fit or fill. Fat and unknown boards default to a conservative safe video path. 480i/480p follows the Xbox dashboard; each board still needs hardware validation.
large_description: Four languages, including Arabic. Larger text in HD; enabled automatically on SD TVs.
large_alt: HD home screen with large text
fill_description: Keep the full picture with letterboxing, or crop to fill the screen without stretching.

release_summaries.local: Watch later and resume without an account validated on Xbox. Account lists stay separate.
release_summaries.search: Search filters and suggestions validated with the Xbox controller; channel and playlist results open their pages.
release_summaries.sponsor: SponsorBlock’s skip button validated with the controller. Off and automatic modes are also available; community segments can be wrong.
release_summaries.quality: 1080p30 validated on Xbox: action at 30.00 fps without frame loss; football at 29.97 fps with one sync correction per minute, matching 720p. Sharp output with dashboard 1080p; downscaling at 720p can alias in fast motion.
release_summaries.music: Account Music validated on Xbox, with recent plays, playlists and likes through the TV client.
release_summaries.app_updates: Signed app updates with startup confirmation and recovery of the previous version. Reopen the launcher to install.
release_summaries.traffic_fix: Videos open again when Google flags your IP for unusual traffic.
release_summaries.dislike_fix: Estimated dislike counts load in the player again.
release_summaries.cast_name: The casting identity now uses Tube360 or the name you chose for the app.
release_summaries.cast_limit: TV-code pairing works. The console does not yet appear by itself in the phone’s cast list.
release_summaries.native: Watch directly on Xbox 360 with native H.264 video and AAC sound. A PC becomes an optional reserve.
release_summaries.account: Connect your account with a TV code for recommendations, subscriptions, playlists and history.
release_summaries.comments: Read and scroll comments with the controller and see estimated dislike counts.
release_summaries.speed: Choose eight speeds from 0.25× to 2× while keeping the voice pitch. You can also repeat the video.
release_summaries.crt: A 4:3 layout for CRT TVs, safe margins, large text and Spanish alongside Portuguese and English.
release_summaries.rule_updates: Signed YouTube rule fixes arrive without replacing the whole app, with recovery of the previous rules.
release_summaries.search_rows: Search results no longer leave an empty row between rows.
release_summaries.shorts_row: Shorts sit in one row of smaller cards, and you can hide them in Settings.
release_summaries.nest_busy: A busy Nest no longer hangs the video: it starts on the TV, and X retries the Nest.
release_summaries.members_message: Members-only videos and lives say clearly that they can’t play on Xbox yet.
release_summaries.error_reports: Automatic, sanitized error reports after a crash or failed start, with an off switch in Settings.
release_summaries.large_mp4: Videos above 2 GiB now open correctly on Xbox after a fix for a GCC optimization defect.
